entries.en: Ah, but now I suppose you're wondering why all the fuss over a shortsword? That's easy, you see. This isn't your ordinary, run-of-the-mill, mass-forged, store-bought, bottom-of-the-bargain-bin shortsword. This here is a genuine <colortype(500)><edgecolortype(501)>aetherial<edgecolortype(0)><colortype(0)> shortsword. One of a kind, in fact.

entries.en: A deal!? Hah! Do you know how long it took me to find this? How many parties I was forced to suffer with greedy bastards who kept claiming all the aetherial loot even though their bags were full of the stuff? No, this sword is <italic(1)>mine<italic(0)>, and if you want it, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands!

entries.en: Which, in truth, is how aetherial gear comes to be. You've heard of spiritbonds, I assume? That spiritually charged aetherial connection you form with any gear you have equipped? Well, in rare cases, when someone wielding an item with an especially strong spiritbond is slain in battle, the energy created by that bond remains trapped inside, rather than returning to the Lifestream.
entries.fr: Si vous en voulez une semblable, il faudra vous la procurer vous-même<nbsp>! Dans l'Hypogée de Tam-Tara, par exemple. Pourquoi<nbsp>? Eh bien, parce que c'est un endroit mortel où beaucoup perdent la vie, pardi.

元の持ち主が、命を散らせたときに
放たれたエーテルが装備に宿ったものなんだ。

entries.en: That energy enhances the gear, and voilà! You have an aetherial shortsword, or an aetherial subligar, or a pair of aetherial goatskin smithy gloves of gathering.
entries.fr: Vous savez ce qu'est la symbiose, non<nbsp>? Normalement, cette connexion entre un équipement et son porteur disparaît quand ce dernier meurt, mais il arrive parfois que l'énergie éthérée reste emprisonnée dans l'objet.

entries.en: The fact that for an item to become aetherial, the owner of that item must perish while having it equipped, usually means that they can only be found in dangerous locations where terrible, bloody battles have occurred. Now, if <italic(1)>I<italic(0)> was looking to get <italic(1)>my<italic(0)> hands on <italic(1)>another<italic(0)> aetherial weapon, might be that I'd head back inside Sastasha. \<wink> \<wink>
